name: Aghori
detailed_description:
Aghori is a psychological horror game rooted in Indian mysticism, set in the haunting foothills of the Himalayas. Step into the shoes of Rudra, a determined seeker who dares to go beyond fear and discomfort in search of his missing friends. His journey leads to an isolated, forgotten village surrounded by a cursed forest hiding unspeakable rituals and ancient secrets.

Unravel a dark narrative where ancient beliefs, supernatural forces, and emotional trauma collide. The game weaves rich storytelling, eerie atmosphere, and immersive exploration into a heart-shaking journey of courage, sacrifice, and spiritual confrontation.

🧘 Key Features

  • 🎭 Narrative-Driven Horror – Experience a powerful, emotionally heavy story full of mystery, fear, and revelation.

  • 🌲 Atmospheric Exploration – Traverse abandoned temples, cursed shrines, and ritual sites deep in the forest.

  • 🔍 Uncover the Past – Discover ancient rites, spiritual relics, and dark truths hidden beneath centuries of silence.

  • 🎮 First-Person Immersion – Feel every heartbeat, whisper, and shadow through immersive storytelling and sound design.

  • 🧩 Solve Symbolic Puzzles – Decipher puzzles inspired by ancient Indian philosophy and esoteric traditions.
